name: Saoirse O'Malley
bio:
Saoirse O'Malley discovered her passion for motorsport early, spending her childhood tinkering with engines on her family's farm in County Cork. This hands-on experience led her to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, where she excelled in materials science and fabrication techniques. After graduating, she joined a local rally team, quickly earning a reputation for her innovative problem-solving and meticulous approach to vehicle construction. Her expertise in welding and composite materials became invaluable, ensuring the team's cars were not only fast but also incredibly durable. 

Saoirse’s move to Crown Racing was a turning point. She now specializes in chassis and suspension fabrication, constantly seeking ways to improve vehicle performance through cutting-edge materials and design. While she is a highly respected member of the team, Saoirse prefers working independently, often found late in the workshop, meticulously perfecting her craft. Her dedication and keen eye for detail make her an indispensable asset, even if her independent streak can sometimes cause friction.

What sets Saoirse apart is her ability to envision the entire vehicle as a cohesive unit, understanding how each component interacts with the others. This holistic perspective allows her to identify potential weaknesses and optimize the vehicle for peak performance, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport fabrication.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Saoirse is of average height with a lean build, reflecting years spent working with metal and machinery.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils with a pocketknife, even in the digital age.
Insists on listening to traditional Irish music while working, claiming it improves her focus.
Has an uncanny ability to identify metal fatigue simply by tapping on it.
